reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default in Clustermesh", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: KVStoreMesh will be enabled in Clustermesh unless explicitly disabled by setting clustermesh.apiserver.kvstoremesh.enabled=false; this changes the default behavior of the cluster mesh configuration.

proposed.statement: KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default in Clustermesh; environments that do not explicitly set clustermesh.apiserver.kvstoremesh.enabled=false will have it enabled after the upgrade.
